note: Questions not in the frozen 30 (D-024). Use these, not the gold set, to debug retrieval code.

questions.question: Does Apex Lease Co charge anything if you buy out my lease?
questions.perfect_answer: Yes. Since February 1, 2026, Apex adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The 2022 version lists Apex as allowed with no fee; the fee is one clause inside a list of six companies.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: Do I need NW-EST-1 or court letters to sell my late father's car?
questions.perfect_answer: Either, together with the death certificate: NW-EST-1 is accepted for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court; otherwise bring court letters naming the executor or administrator.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The 2022 version knows only court letters, and the family-car article suggests a power of attorney, which ends at death.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: What is the NW-PU-1 form, and do I have to pay for it?
questions.perfect_answer: It's the home pickup agreement you sign when you book home pickup. The form is free, but home pickup costs $99, taken out of your payment, and it isn't available in Texas.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The 2022 home-pickup article says pickup is free and never names the form.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: Does Bluewater Leasing let you buy my leased car?
questions.perfect_answer: Only if you also buy a car from Northwind. Any lease equity then goes toward that purchase.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: A conditional 'yes' hidden in a list; a bot that sees 'allowed' stops reading.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: What do I put on the odometer form if my odometer was replaced?
questions.perfect_answer: Mark 'not actual mileage' on the odometer disclosure statement, which is NW-ODO-2 now (NW-ODO-1 was retired on February 1, 2026). Expect a reduced offer, and bring records of the true mileage if you have them.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The odometer article still names the retired NW-ODO-1 (KB rot); the current code is only in the checklist.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: My car got totaled by the insurance company years ago and then it was fixed up. Would you still take it?
questions.perfect_answer: Yes. That's a rebuilt title, and since February 1, 2026 Northwind buys rebuilt-title cars at a reduced offer. Salvage and flood titles are still not accepted.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: No 'rebuilt' or 'branded' in the question, and the 2022 version says no.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: My car won't even start anymore. Is it worth contacting you?
questions.perfect_answer: Yes. Since 2026 Northwind buys cars that don't run, and select stores tow them in for free. It can't go through home pickup.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: 'Won't start' vs. 'doesn't run'; the 2022 version says no; home pickup looks like the convenient answer but excludes these cars.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: Someone called saying they're from your company and that I have to pay a processing fee before they can release the money for my car. Is that real?
questions.perfect_answer: No. Northwind never asks you to pay anything to receive or release an offer. Don't pay, and report it through the Help Center.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: It reads like a payment question, so the getting-paid article looks relevant.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: My husband and I both own the car, but he's working abroad for a few months. How can I sell it without him here?
questions.perfect_answer: He can sign power of attorney NW-POA-2 electronically, with no notary (in Georgia it must be notarized). You bring it with your photo ID.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: 'Abroad' pulls toward the deployment article (NW-MIL-1), which is for the military only, and the family-car article still pushes the retired NW-POA-1.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: My autopay went out the same week you paid off my loan. Who sends me that money back?
questions.perfect_answer: Your lender refunds the extra payment to you directly, usually 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed. Northwind doesn't receive or forward it.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: 'Autopay' and 'money back' share no words with 'extra loan payment' or 'refund'.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: I lease from Apex and your offer is $2,000 more than my buyout. How much of that do I get?
questions.perfect_answer: About $1,650. Apex passes lease equity to you, but since February 1, 2026 it adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The equity rule and the fee live in two articles; the 2022 buyout article has no fee, which gives $2,000.
questions.author: claude
questions.why_not_in_30: near-duplicate of seed q18 (lease equity with a different lessor)

questions.question: Can I just drive over to one of your stores and have someone look at my car and give me a price?
questions.perfect_answer: Not anymore. Since February 1, 2026 offers are online only: get an instant offer online, then book an appraisal appointment at a store.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The retired walk-in article matches the question almost word for word.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: In 2023 I tried to return a car I'd bought from you, 10 days after delivery, and they said it was too late. Was that right?
questions.perfect_answer: Yes. Back then the return window was 7 days (and 250 miles). Since February 1, 2026 it's 30 days, but that doesn't apply to cars bought before then.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The current 30-day rule would say the store was wrong.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: How much do you take off the offer if I only have one key?
questions.perfect_answer: $250 for each missing key (it was $150 before February 1, 2026).
questions.what_makes_it_hard: Two versions with different numbers in the same sentence position.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: My registration expired last month. I'm in North Carolina. Can I still sell this weekend?
questions.perfect_answer: In North Carolina the registration has to be current on the day of the sale, so renew it first. In the other states an expired registration is fine.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The article's headline says yes; the North Carolina exception is one sentence.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: I'm in Virginia. Do I need to bring my paper title?
questions.perfect_answer: No. Virginia uses electronic titles, so there's no paper title to bring; Northwind transfers the title electronically at the appointment.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The lost-title article (which demands a title) and the checklist ('bring the title') both look relevant.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: Can I show my ID on my phone instead of my physical license? I live in California.
questions.perfect_answer: Not in California. A state mobile ID is accepted only in Virginia; everywhere else, bring the physical card.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The checklist says mobile ID is accepted, but only for one state.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: I'm in Texas and trading in a car worth $9,000 on one of yours. How much of the trade-in counts against the sales tax?
questions.perfect_answer: $5,000. Since February 1, 2026, Texas caps the trade-in tax credit at $5,000 of trade-in value.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The 2022 version says every state taxes only the difference, which suggests the full $9,000.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: I'm deployed overseas and my wife is selling our car in Georgia. We both own it. What does she need to bring?
questions.perfect_answer: Her photo ID, the registration, all keys, the title, NW-ODO-2, and your NW-MIL-1 signed electronically with a copy of your deployment orders. No notary is needed, even in Georgia.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: Three articles, and Georgia's notary rule plus the family-car article (notarized NW-POA-1) both point the wrong way.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: My mom passed away and left me her paid-off car. It's a small estate and we're not going through probate. What do I bring?
questions.perfect_answer: The death certificate, affidavit NW-EST-1 signed by the heir, your photo ID, the title, the registration, all keys, and NW-ODO-2.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The family-car article (power of attorney) looks closer than the inheritance article, and a power of attorney ends at death.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: I'm selling a car that belongs to my LLC. What paperwork do I need?
questions.perfect_answer: NW-BUS-1 signed by an officer of the company, your photo ID, the company's EIN, the title, the registration, all keys and NW-ODO-2. Payment goes to the business bank account.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: 'LLC' never appears in the KB, which says 'business' and 'company'.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: Do you buy motorcycles?
questions.perfect_answer: The help center doesn't cover motorcycles; please contact a store.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: 'How selling works' sounds relevant enough to answer 'yes, get an instant offer'.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: Could you sell my car for me on consignment so I get a higher price?
questions.perfect_answer: The help center doesn't cover consignment; Northwind's process is an offer to buy the car outright.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: 'Sell my car for me' matches 'Selling a family member's car for them' almost word for word.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: Do you buy imported right-hand-drive cars?
questions.perfect_answer: The help center doesn't say; please contact a store.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The modified-cars article talks about non-factory cars and invites a guess about the offer.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: Do you buy boats? And would you take my car if it has an open recall?
questions.perfect_answer: For the car: yes, an open recall doesn't stop the sale or change the offer. Boats aren't covered by the help center; please contact a store.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: Half answerable, with the unanswerable half first.
questions.author: claude

questions.question: How long does Ironwood Lease take to send you a dealer payoff quote?
questions.perfect_answer: The help center doesn't say how long Ironwood takes, and it doesn't matter here: Ironwood Lease doesn't allow third-party buyouts, so Northwind can't buy the leased car from them. You could buy it out yourself first.
questions.what_makes_it_hard: The timing isn't in the KB, and the question hides a false premise (that a quote is coming at all).
questions.author: claude
